title: CoreWeave Leads an AI Rebound as Nasdaq Climbs on the Veterans Day Session
dek: Stocks traded higher through the first half of a bond-free Wednesday, with CoreWeave's earnings-driven surge and a Nvidia bounce doing most of the lifting.
author: Meridian Newsroom

body:
US stocks traded higher on Wednesday, Veterans Day, in a session with the bond market closed. Stock markets followed their usual schedule. The Federal Reserve was also closed.

## Where the indexes stood

At 8:57 a.m. Pacific, Yahoo Finance's live report put the S&P 500 up about 1.2% and the Nasdaq Composite up about 1.9%, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average near flat. By 12:00 p.m. Eastern, Yahoo's quote data showed the Nasdaq Composite at 25,582.06, up 2.06%. The index moves in this piece are intraday readings, not closing numbers.

## CoreWeave drives the tape

CoreWeave was the day's clearest mover. CNBC reported that the AI cloud provider's shares rose about 20% after it posted third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, up 168% from a year earlier, against a $3.55 billion consensus from LSEG. The company also raised its full-year revenue outlook. Yahoo Finance quoted CoreWeave at $61.33, up 25.86%, at 12:00 p.m. Eastern.

The stock's reaction was driven by financing, not only revenue. Yahoo Finance reported that CoreWeave expects about $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits over the next three months and does not plan to take on more expensive debt through 2027. Its bonds had sold off in recent weeks as investors questioned the cost of funding its build-out.

## Nvidia and the chip bounce

Nvidia rose about 5% after two losing sessions. CNBC said the stock had been down nearly 10% for the week before Wednesday. Yahoo Finance reported that chip stocks broadly rallied on the CoreWeave results and that Nvidia still trailed its early-November level.

## What did not move the tape

There was no major US economic release or large earnings calendar on Wednesday, according to Yahoo Finance. With Treasuries shut, the last reliable rate reading remains Tuesday's 4.98% close on the 10-year note, per CNN Business. Traders will look for the first clean bond reaction on Thursday.

## What to watch next

Nebius reports third-quarter results before the open on Thursday, Nov. 12, according to Yahoo Finance and GuruFocus. Yahoo Finance said early Wednesday trading had already lifted Nebius about 15% on the CoreWeave read-through.

marketImpact.summary: The rebound is concentrated in AI infrastructure names, and CoreWeave's financing update is the main reason. Broader gains are real but narrower than the headline indexes suggest.
